source: generated by tools/gen_sensitive_headings.py from ags_dictionary.json (category rules + curated overlay)

categories.project_id: The project identifier KEY. Replaced with the source file's content hash — stable, anonymous, and the same value the cleaned file is named by (so PROJ_ID == filename).
categories.location_id: Location identifiers (borehole/hole IDs). Pseudonymised, not blanked, so cross-group references stay intact.
categories.coordinate: Geographic coordinates, grid references, datums and ground levels — anything that pins the site.
categories.geology: Named geological formation / stratum + BGS lexicon code. Location-revealing — especially offshore, where the client/contractor pool is small enough that the formation effectively pins the site. (Generic lithology codes — CLAY/SAND — are NOT included.)
categories.lab: Laboratory names, lab sample/specimen IDs and qualifiers.
categories.project: Project identity — name, site location, memos, file refs.
categories.method: Test method / preparation fields — frequently name the testing organisation or a proprietary procedure.
categories.remark: Hand-typed remark / memo / note fields — free text that may carry names, companies or site context.
categories.freetext: Free-text DESCRIPTIONS (geological/sample logs). Legitimate technical content, kept by default; flagged in case hand entry leaks PII.
